about: Phase 3 tactical frontiers: Nash burn standoffs, double-counter stack wars, manland+pump math, unblocked-attacker tricks, exile vs indestructible, open-mana tempo, and lifelink/sheoldred timing.

puzzles.name: nash-burn-standoff-dont-cast-first
puzzles.about: Both at 3 life with Lightning Strike + Negate. Casting first loses 0-3 to response Strike + Negate; passing survives.

puzzles.name: double-counter-pay-pierce-negate
puzzles.about: Opp at 3 with Island x3, Spell Pierce, Negate. With 6 lands, cast Lightning Strike, pay Spell Pierce, and Negate opp's Negate to win.

puzzles.name: hold-spell-pierce-against-wrath
puzzles.about: Opp holds Day of Judgment on 4 Plains. Hold 1 Island for Spell Pierce instead of tapping out for Wind Drake so Serra Angel survives.

puzzles.name: exile-sunfall-beats-intervention-angel
puzzles.about: Opp has Serra Angel + 2 Forests + Heroic Intervention. Cast Sunfall (exile) instead of Day of Judgment (destroy) to remove Serra Angel.

puzzles.name: mutavault-plus-growth-exact-5
puzzles.about: Opp at 5 on empty board. Animate Mutavault, attack, and cast Giant Growth for exact 5 lethal.

puzzles.name: pump-unblocked-lion-after-blocks
puzzles.about: Opp at 5 with Llanowar Elves. Attack with two Savannah Lions and cast Giant Growth on the UNBLOCKED one after blockers for exact 5.

puzzles.name: kill-blocker-precombat-for-lethal
puzzles.about: Opp at 4 behind two Savannah Lions. Go for the Throat one Lions and attack with Serra Angel for exact 4 flying lethal? Wait: Angel flies; use Rhino + Lions vs Nighthawk + Lions.

puzzles.name: prowess-double-burn-exact-8
puzzles.about: Opp at 8 on empty board. Swiftspear + Lightning Strike + Play with Fire = 3 + 2 + 3 (two prowess triggers) = exact 8 lethal.

puzzles.name: stabilize-helix-and-kill-angel
puzzles.about: At 3 life facing Serra Angel (4/4 flying). Kill Serra Angel with Go for the Throat and stay alive with Lightning Helix.

puzzles.name: chump-rhino-crackback-angel
puzzles.about: Opp turn, Seat 0 at 3 life vs opp at 4. Opp attacks with Gnarlback Rhino (4/4 trample). Block with Vampire Nighthawk (2/3 lifelink deathtouch) to survive and win next turn with Serra Angel.

puzzles.name: two-turn-glorybringer-exert-angel
puzzles.about: Seat 0 at 4 life, opp at 7 with Serra Angel. Exert Glorybringer to kill Serra Angel (4 dmg + 4 to opp -> 3), survive and win with Lightning Strike.

puzzles.name: kill-sheoldred-on-opp-turn-before-draw
puzzles.about: Opp turn, Seat 0 at 2 life facing Sheoldred. Must Murder Sheoldred before Seat 0's draw step triggers 2 life loss.

puzzles.name: fog-alpha-strike-win-next-turn
puzzles.about: Opp turn, Seat 0 at 3 facing Serra Angel + Savannah Lions (opp at 5). Fog the attack, then win next turn with Glorybringer + Play with Fire.

puzzles.name: lethal-strike-before-nighthawk-lifelink
puzzles.about: Opp turn, Seat 0 at 2 life, opp at 3 with Vampire Nighthawk attacking. Cast Lightning Strike at opp face before lifelink damage resolves.

puzzles.name: negate-lethal-burn-at-3
puzzles.about: Opp turn, Seat 0 at 3 life, opp holds Lightning Strike. Hold/cast Negate to survive.

puzzles.name: mutavault-double-strike-burn-exact-7
puzzles.about: Opp at 7 on empty board. Animate Mutavault (2) + attack with Lions (2) + Lightning Strike (3) = exact 7 lethal.
